name: Athens International Airport

curfew.v: No curfew; the airport operates 24 hours (operator's statement, December 2024).

handling.v: The airport company awards and supervises ground handling and does not run it itself; its page lists the handling companies, without saying which serve business aviation.
handling.quote: Athens International Airport (AIA) is responsible for the award and supervision of Ground Handling services.

slots.v: Temporarily fully coordinated (Level 3) because of runway works, for winter 2026/27 (25 Oct 2026 to 27 Mar 2027) and summer 2027. GA/BA flights get slots from the slot coordinator (HSCA) under its rules; aircraft-registration-only flights must use a representative. Western runway system closed 5 Nov to 18 Dec 2026 and 18 to 23 Feb 2027; on it, take-offs only up to ICAO Cat C 3 Jan to 17 Feb 2027. From 25 Oct 2026 a Flight Plan Suspension Program applies to GA/BA flights at ATH (HSCA notice; details in the linked NOTAM, not read)
slots.quote: temporarily designated as a Level 3 (Fully Coordinated) airport for W26

also.quote: ATH will be temporarily designated as a Level 3 (Fully Coordinated) airport for the S27 season.
Airport slots for General & Business Aviation flights must be cleared according to the issued Rules and Guidelines.
W26 Flight Plan Suspension Program for General and Business Aviation flights operating at ATH airport

ppr.v: Winter 2026/27: GA/BA slot requests are taken no earlier than 7 days before the flight. Maximum ground time 90 minutes, minimum 20. Longer stays, or aircraft types not declared for the stand, need a PPR apron clearance from the airport first, and its confirmation goes in the slot request. A change to a larger type needs new airport approval. Helicopters are exempt
ppr.quote: maximum Ground Time at Athens International Airport up to 90 minutes

max_aircraft.v: GA/BA stands, winter 2026/27: 4 Category B up to 17 m wingspan; 3 Category B from 17 m up to 23.72 m; 2 Category C for Global 5000-8000, G500-G800, FA6X, FA7X and FA8X, with 90 minutes between a departure and the next arrival. This is a stand limit for GA/BA flights; other Category C to F stands are for commercial traffic unless noted, and the airport's overall maximum aircraft was not read
max_aircraft.quote: CAT C: 2 Category C apron stands are exclusively for allocation of GA-BA flights

runway.v: two parallel runways: the eastern one 4,000 m x 45 m, the western one 3,800 m x 45 m
runway.quote: the Eastern runway is 4,000 meters long and 45 meters wide and the Western runway is 3,800 meters long and 45 meters wide.
